Hawaii just enacted a law that effectively neuters Citizens United.

Montana could soon follow suit via a ballot referendum.

Here's what you should know about the plans to get Big Money out of politics — and how they could be replicated where you live.

The Brown v. Board ruling happened 72 years ago today.

The reversal of the Supreme Court’s previous “separate but equal” decision highlights how it’s possible to overcome bad SCOTUS decisions.

But it took years of activism from brave people to get there.

Keep fighting.

Today, Trump is hosting a prayer event that will “give thanks for God's providence…and rededicate America as One Nation under God.”

All but one speaker are conservative Christians.

He wants to turn our secular democracy into a MAGA theocracy.

Not only is their "Freedom 250" receiving taxpayer funds, it's also soliciting big donations from corporations in exchange for face time with Trump. 

Everything is for sale.

An economic populist movement can unite the worker, the farmer, and the small businessman — across all ethnicities, religions, and political affiliations — against the wealthy elites who have rigged the system against them.

The powerful forces trying to dominate our country want us to fall into cynicism.

That way, they win everything — and they'll be able to take it all without the rest of us putting up a fight.

If you are worried about the future, you are not alone. I am too.

But please do not fall into cynicism.

Pay-to-play corruption.

It’s no secret that rental housing costs are skyrocketing.

But there’s a way for tenants to fight back: tenant unions.

@taraghuveer explains what they are, how they work, and how you can start your own.

He would oversee the fund’s commission.

The corruption is breathtaking

An insane level of corruption—even for Trump.

I'm delighted that I'm able to reach so many of you over social media. But — to borrow a phrase from my younger colleagues — I hope you're all getting a chance to log off and touch grass regularly.
